However, the magic of this spell can only control the target's system for so long before it returns from being purely harmful to its normal state. Syntax: cast drunken stupor at <target> use <booze>

drying wind.name: drying wind
drying wind.description: One of the greatest stories ever told, is how a man with the aid of his god, managed to rescue his people from an evil army by parting an entire sea, so they could cross over on dry land to safety. If one looks deeper into the tales, it is found that this man was one of the first druids. He had gained from his god, the ability to control the element of wind. With the wind at his command he was able to cause it to push the waves asunder, and dry a path for his people. That very spell has passed down through the ages, and is still capable of drying large amounts of water from a given area.

earth blood.name: earth blood
earth blood.description: In winter, all things natural gain comfort and shelter from the earth to survive the frost, for the earth protects its own. This spell triggers that protective nature, bringing Gaia into the target as his blood is chilled, granting the target enhanced endurance and resistance. This spell only works on party members.

earth power.name: earth power
earth power.description: One of the strongest elements known, is the earth itself. It is one of the only constants over the years. This is why it is such a great source of strength, one that druids have relied on for ages. They are able to cast a spell which taps the earth itself and grants great strength to a target for a short time. With this spell active, one may have the strength to move mountains.

earth skin.name: earth skin
earth skin.description: One of the greatest characteritics the earth we live on possesses, is its enduring existance. Wars, floods, earthquakes, nothing has been able to destroy it. The mountains we see, have stood for ages, virtually untouched by wind and rain. One of the druids spells, is able to grant the target the strength and protection of the mountains. The target's skin becomes as hard as the mountains themselves. This spell is even able to be cast over and over, but beware the mountainish have other characteristics besides endurance, that may not be as desirable.

earthquake.name: earthquake
earthquake.description: The druids are master of the earth itself. Upon command, they can cause the ground to shake and split apart and engulf their foes. This not only damages them from the flying rocks and debris, it also is a very disruptive experience. It's hard to keep your thoughts straight when the ground beneath you is being ripped apart. Chances are, any spell you were weaving, or skill you were attempting to execute will be lost in the tremors.

electric field.name: electric field
electric field.description: All monsters and players within the forcefield will be jolted with electricity every once in a while. The caster can remove this spell by typing 'remove field' here. The higher your level is, and the higher you have Theory of Electrical Engineering trained the better the field is.

electrocution.name: electrocution
electrocution.description: While lightning is considered by many to be the epitamy of electric power, true electric mages are able to tap into the elements and wield pure electric energy. By drawing enough power and directing it at a specific target, they are able to unleash a tremendous electric shock onto  the victim. This shock is so powerful it can literally knock even the largest target off their feet, lifting them into the  air, writhing in agony, as the electricity sparks and crackles around them.

elemental soul ward.name: elemental soul ward
elemental soul ward.description: With this spell you can protect your animal soul mount or soul companion from certain element. Valid elements are physical, magical, fire, cold, poison, electricity, asphyxiation, psionic and acid, but you can also use their four letter abbreviations.Protecting your soul from harm is an important task, especially when it is not bound in your body. This spell gives the tools for that. It can also be used to improve the resistance of your animal soul mount - even though getting one killed won't hurt as much as getting your soul killed.Usage: cast elemental soul ward at <name of element> on <soul|mount>

end enthrallment.name: end enthrallment
end enthrallment.description: The caster can bestow gift on someone, but as quickly as someone has received such a gift, it can be recalled and ended. When Nergal recalls ends the enthrallment the parasite inside the host is left in dormant state. Depending on parasite the connection may be reestablished.

energy aura.name: energy aura
energy aura.description: One of the basic spells in the channelling discipline, the aura of power turns the caster into a powerful magic beacon. It becomes far easier for the channeller to retain magic, greatly increasing how much they have at their disposal. Further, the aura fascilitates the flow of magical energies from the caster into spells, substantially increasing the effect of most channeller spells. Maintaining this aura is taxing, as the energy drawn into it comes from all sources, even the caster. Only the strongest and most experienced of casters can keep the spell in effect for very long.

energy channeling.name: energy channeling
energy channeling.description: This spell will reduce some of the electrical damage you receive from electrical damage sources. Layering of different resistances is possible. Wisdom, masteries and power of caster and target affect the duration and the quality of the spell.

energy drain.name: energy drain
energy drain.description: Undeads are feared as opponents due to the many various forms of attack they can throw at their targets. One such attack, is to attempt to drain the life energy from their victim. Many undead thrive on this ability, taking their victims life energy, and claiming it as their own. Those who follow the dark gods also can learn this power and use it to increase their own power. Many dark wizards have gained all their power from sucking out the life of their fallen foes.

energy vortex.name: energy vortex
energy vortex.description: It doesn't matter how much energy you can conjure up if you cannot get it to go anywhere. Channellers, in particular those who find themselves on the wrong end of a troll or rampant golem, need to make sure their spells are taking effect. This spell creates a powerful multi-dimensional wormhole to a magic dead zone, centered on the target's energy signature. While this may sound dangerous -- and it is -- the victim's resistance to raw energy is affected, at least for a few minutes. The spell is stackable, but only up to a point.

enhance vision.name: enhance vision
enhance vision.description: This spell allows the recipient to enhance its vision, and thus being able to see further in cities and other landscape. It lasts for a limited time depending on the level of the caster.

enhanced awareness.name: enhanced awareness
enhanced awareness.description: By creating a kind of sixth sense, the target can become aware of ambushes just before they happen. It can also be used to find ways out of ambushes already in place.

enhanced vitality.name: enhanced vitality
enhanced vitality.description: This spell protects the skin against nasty aging effects.

enthralling parasite.name: enthralling parasite
enthralling parasite.description: The most crucial gift Nergal offers for those who wish to have dominion over lesser creatures. The vile parasite latches itself onto the victim, attempting to burrow its way to their cerebrum, attaching itself to the brain and creating a link between you and the victim. If the poor creature is too weak to resist, it will succumb and become your servant.

entropy.name: entropy
entropy.description: This spell is used to age a player.

enwize.name: enwize
enwize.description: This spell affects the recipient's wis. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

escape velocity.name: escape velocity
escape velocity.description: This vortex pulls the caster into a short lived dimensional arc. The other endpoint of the arc can be a player, or one of several 'standard' destinations. The immense pressure that this trip exerts on the traveller is quite painful, but rarely fatal. Mastery of rifts will allow the caster to make a softer landing, as well as shortening the recovery time before casting another vortex.Standard destinations:  Desolathya (deso), Furnachia (furn), Laenor (lae),   Lucentium (lucent), Rothikgen (roth)

establish entity control.name: establish entity control
establish entity control.description: Before you can command your entity to use skills (gem cmd use <skill>), you will need to have control over your entity. This spell will establish a link between you and your entity, allowing you to command it. Without this bond your entity will be very weak and vulnerable. This spell uses 1 rift spark. Extra sparks (max 10) can be used to reduce the spell cost and increase the duration, e.g. cast establish entity control at 3

ether boundary.name: ether boundary
ether boundary.description: Magic has long been used as protection. One such use is the spell which creates an aura around the target that protects them from various asphyxiation spells. This spell also is known by an older name, air shield. While it cannot completely absorb all asphyxiation attacks, it is still able to take the brunt of the attack, perhaps saving the target's life.

evaluate host.name: evaluate host
evaluate host.description: Successful enthrallment of an host depends on various things, such as hosts general toughness, casters evolution progress and are there other enthralled minions to support the caster. By commanding the parasite to evaluate the host before enthralling it gives valuable information about the host and casters chance to enthrall it.

evoke toad.name: evoke toad
evoke toad.description: The denizens of the swamp are very important to all those servants and aspiring priests who serve their god Burglefloogah. The servants of darkness revere the marsh people more than they respect their own colleagues. While the servants of darkness keep each other in high esteem, they prefer to use as much of their time on the marshes to serve their master. While all frogs and toads are seen as kindred spirits, the regular frogs and toads lack the intelligence what is required to leave an everlasting mark into the swamp society. Because of that, the servants use magic to evoke frogs and help them to use their full capacity. The toads that are mentally awoken may perform different tasks and may even act as rulers of swamp domains. It's said that the contribution of the toad is often related to the wisdom and knowledge of the spell of the casting priest. The elder priests also warn that one should not choose toads that are likely to dominate other toads too much as cooperation gives the best results.

eyes of nature.name: eyes of nature
eyes of nature.description: This spell helps the caster to detect life signs from his surroundings. Sometimes complex structures may distort the vision.

feather weight.name: feather weight
feather weight.description: This spell reduces the weight of the target object. Knowledge of metamorphosis increases the effects of this spell

feeblemind.name: feeblemind
feeblemind.description: This spell affects the recipient's int. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

field of fear.name: field of fear
field of fear.description: This spell, when cast, creates an aura of uncertainty. This feeling permeates the air, causing one to lose confidence, truly testing one's bravery. If one has not completely dedicated himself to being there, he may lose heart and flee. Those who are strong willed and determined, are able to shrug off the effects of this spell. Those who are uncertain about their abilities are the most vulnerable to this spell.

field of light.name: field of light
field of light.description: Everyone who enters in this field have possibility to lose the heavy weight.

field of poison.name: field of poison
field of poison.description: The field enhances the poison damage dealt in the room.

fire blast.name: fire blast
fire blast.description: The strongest of the pure fire attack spells, is the spell fire blast. Unlike the weaker spells, firebolt and flame arrow, this spell taps directly into the plane of fire, drawing a large amount of  energy that can be directed upon the target in one concentrated blast. While this requires more effort then either of the two smaller spells, its power is also much greater.

fire of the saints.name: fire of the saints
fire of the saints.description: The Light of Las is a truly magnificient thing, able to cure the injured and burn the wicked. With this spell, one may request that the benefits of the Light be shed upon one's ship. If the request is granted, the ship will begin to glow with holy light which tends to blind those of evil intent who look upon it. Rumors exist of other magnificent benefits which can be bestowed, if the caster is especially pure in their faith.

firebolt.name: firebolt
firebolt.description: The spell firebolt is a more powerful version of the simple spell, flame arrow. Instead of a fiery arrow, a larger, more powerful bolt of flame leaps from the fingertips of the caster onto the target. This spell take a little more concentration and effort then the less powerful spell flame arrow, but also has much more potential.

flame arrow.name: flame arrow
flame arrow.description: The most basic of the attack spells which draw on the element of fire, is the spell flame arrow. On command, a fiery arrow appears and directs itself at the desired target. While it may not be as powerful as some of the other incantations of fire, it can be cast with ease, requiring a mere thought.

flame shield.name: flame shield
flame shield.description: The idea behind the flame shield is the same as the method used by some elves to prevent the spread of a fire. A smaller, controlled fire that clears the path of the larger fire can stop it in its tracks. This spell surrounds the target with a harmless sheet of flame that can drastically reduce or possibly even eliminate fire and heat damage.

flames of righteousness.name: flames of righteousness
flames of righteousness.description: Flames of Righteousness is an excellent spell when facing multiple enemies of evil alignment at the same time. When successfully cast, the surroundings of the caster will burst into white holy flames, and all fiendish entities within range will undergo tremendous pain as blazing flames purify their worthless souls. Knowledge of dispelling increases the effect of this spell.

flaming ice.name: flaming ice
flaming ice.description: Another cold based spell that is often misunderstood is the spell flaming ice. This spell does not actually use ice that is on fire, though to many this is what it does actually look like. Small sheets of magically enhanced ice are thrown at the target. They are so cold that they glow bright enough to look like that are actually on fire, but  this is not the case. Upon impact with the target, they  shatter against it, which causes damage to the target.

flex shield.name: flex shield
flex shield.description: One of the most useful spells that druids have at their disposal, is the art of taking the immediate surrounding elements of a target, and tuning them so they protect the target. Using the air, water, light, or whatever else happens to be available, they are able to create a barrier that is capable of absorbing and deflecting damage of any kind away from the target. This spell's good is evident as the air around the target  'wobbles' whenever the flexible, or flex for short, shield deflects damage away.

flip.name: flip
flip.description: The ancient spell known as flip, is one of the more devious spells known. The target, if affected, is immediately turned in his alignment. This spell is used to cause chaos in the ranks of large numbers of individuals. Those who are working for the forces of good, suddenly must deal with an evil presence among themselves. Many types of power granted by gods, are dependant on the follower being of a certain alignment. Usually the only way to remove this spell's effects, are to have it cast again, or undergo whatever rituals the gods demand to regain ones favor in their sight.

floating.name: floating
floating.description: This spell dates back to the origin of practiced magic. One of the earliest tests of magical power, was the ability to magically lift and support objects without any assistance except from the magic itself. By keeping only a minor amount of concentration, a caster can make himself float off of the ground. This helps him avoid any perils that might come from having contact with the ground, such as floating over water.

floating disc.name: floating disc
floating disc.description: This spell creates a disc that floats in the air behind you. You can put things in it so that it carries them for you. Maximum duration for this spell is LVL/2 minutes, but in any case it will last at least 2 minutes. You can also update the floating time by casting the spell at certain disc. Floating discs are known to be unstable. You can refer a floating disc with "<owner>'s disc", or "my disc", which works for the owner. If mud crashes, you lose the items on the disc.  POOF. Note:  You can 'dissipate' or 'dispel' your floating disc if you wish to end the spell prematurely.

floating letters.name: floating letters
floating letters.description: Magic can be used for many different purposes. One of the more trivial spells that have been learned, is the spell that allows a wizard to trace words in the air. The letters will stay until someone touches them. Once this happens, they disappear, since this magic is very unstable. Whoever left the words in the air, might not be to happy if he returns and finds them gone though!

forbidden wards.name: forbidden wards
forbidden wards.description: The sun bid farewell and welcomed the twilight. Adriora sighed in relief. She had lost the oppressors who were chasing her. She looked at the opal that the garnet crow had shown her. It glistened in moonlight towards the starlit sky. The strange item's hypnotic effect made her fall asleep almost instantly. As she woke up, she noticed that the garnet crow was still there. It was sitting there on a tree branch watching her through the night, as if it was her own guardian angel sent to her by Heliana. Adriora was thirsty. The morning dew had turned the forest moist and there was just enough of water for her to collect before she continued to walk through the forest until she arrived to an open field. She could see the Shouting Mountains in the horizon as she was approaching Serinna. Then suddenly she heard sounds of horses galloping in the distance. Adriora turned around and saw six riders approaching her with their ranseurs ready. The riders surrounded Adriora. The leader of the riders spoke to Adriora: "It's too late now. There is no way out.", but then the garnet crow spoke: "You fools!" The riders looked at the talking crow in disbelief when it spoke again: "This is sacred ground. You're forbidden to be here." and with that second the dry stalks of grass were on fire burning intensely hot, driving the horses into panic. As the riders were fighting to control their horses Adriora ran as fast as she could without looking back. But had she looked, she would have noticed that there was no longer anything to run away from.

force absorption.name: force absorption
force absorption.description: Easily the most common spell used to protect oneself, is the spell that creates a magical aura which gives resistance to any physical attack. While it is not possible to make one immune to these attacks, it is possible to drastically reduce damage done. This spell draws its resilience from the earth itself, causing it to give a brownish aura around the target.

force dome.name: force dome
force dome.description: Psionicists can use their minds to perform many fantastic feats. By using their minds, they can make an area impassable, creating a barrier with their mind, that allows noone to enter the room. The barrier is unable to last forever, but while it is up, it is virtually impenetrable.

force shield.name: force shield
force shield.description: Psionicists are able to use their mental powers to cover one of their comrades, or themselves, with a telekinetic force shield. This shield is able to physically deflect blows aimed at the target, causing them to glance away, without even touching the target. The shield is invisible, but its effects are very apparent.

forget.name: forget
forget.description: Psionicists can use their mental powers to strike their opponents with many fearful types of attacks. One such technique, is to overload the target's mind, rendering its short-term memory useless. This spell's effects only last a few moments, but while inflicted with this spell, spell words are impossible to remember, preventing one from casting any magic spells. Physical maneuvers learned, are also lost, unable to be executed until one can gain their memory.
forget.spell_vocals: sulta taiat pois, mulle hyva mieli taikadaikaduu

forked lightning.name: forked lightning
forked lightning.description: While most electric based spells are only able to mimic the effects of lightning on a smaller scale, this spell is able to use lightning in its full form, no downsizing. Those hit with this spell are actually hit with a genuine lightning bolt from a major thunderstorm. Many times those hit will lose conciousness and suffer short term memory loss. These bolts are able to create intense heat and damage to skin and muscle tissue.

foul drought.name: foul drought
foul drought.description: The victims entire being is weighed down by the malicious disease assaulting their system. They also emit a slight aura of unease which makes any nearby thrall attack them particularly viciously. This spell is in effect while emitting aura through embracing gifts bestowed upon the acolyte by Lord Nergal and thus it cannot be casted by normal means.

frost insulation.name: frost insulation
frost insulation.description: There are many different instances, when bitter cold can inflict a person. Ranging from magical spells, to winter storms, to powerful attack methods used by monsters such white dragons. Using a special magical spell, one can cover a target with an insulating protective aura. This aura helps reduce the degree of power that any damaging cold attacks have. While it cannot completely prevent damage, it is still able to reduce it greatly.

frost shield.name: frost shield
frost shield.description: The frost shield is a powerful energy barrier that acts as a powerful one-way heat valve. It hinders outside forces from robbing the target of heat, drastically reducing or possibly completely blocking any cold damage.

fury of nature.name: fury of nature
fury of nature.description: The followers of Tzarakk have long been able to agitate nature into violent outbursts against just about everyone else. This spell allows the follower to call upon the powers of nature to attack the invaders, which in the case of Tzarakk means basically anyone except themselves.

gangrenous coils.name: gangrenous coils
gangrenous coils.description: They say that death is as inevitable as dusk. Just like a day is followed by a night, is life followed by death. What connects these both events is that their nature is cyclical. Eventually darkness fades and light takes over, if only for a while. The followers of the dark know that there are many aspects to death. It can be swift, or it can be slow. Sometimes it's gruesome while sometimes more merciful. While being subjected to gangrenous coils is not at all a painless way to go, the death may be relatively swift in the hands of an experienced spellcaster.

gem fire.name: gem fire
gem fire.description: Druids are able to tap into many different forms of nature in order to create their magical powers. Gems are one of natures greatest works. Over time, minerals are formed into gems, through terrific pressure. Druids use the energy stored within the gem during creation to fuel an attack spell, called gem fire. The gem and the energy within is instantly transformed into magical energy that shoots from the casters fingertips to the target. Syntax: cast gem fire at use <gem> [target] 	cast gem fire at [target] use <gem>

ghost armour.name: ghost armour
ghost armour.description: Transforms the selected ghost into a ghost armour. This spell resembles the process of ghost weapon summoning, but the duration is shorter. You cannot compel a ghost to protect anyone else but yourself.Ghost armour was overlooked by the ghost liberators until a fateful clash with the undead hordes of a lich king. The first wave of the ghost liberators was destroyed completely, and the second wave managed to escape suffering major losses. The enchanted claws of the zombies were just too much for mundane armours. The commander of the ghost liberators of that time found the solution from this simple spell, and with the help of some outcast templars who had joined the ghost liberators the lich was slain, and the souls bound in his form liberated.Usage: cast ghost armour

ghost chill.name: ghost chill
ghost chill.description: While mostly melee-oriented guild, ghost liberators have two offensive spells. This is the second one. The spell imbues the target with ghost chill. The chill is harmless to weapons, or actually it gives the weapon the ability to deal the same damage types as the spell. To other targets it is not so harmless - it can freeze and shatter bones and really mess your head. You need a ghost to do the chill, and the ghost is drained but possibly not lost in the process. It is also worth noting that this spell costs some health to cast at an opponent - the angry ghost rarely returns without lashing at the caster, too."First I felt a little chill. It grew to a proper frostbite-cold, nothing out of the ordinary chill touch yet - and then suddenly it was as if someone with chilling claws tried to wrest my brains out of my skull. Nightmarish toughts filled my head. It was horrible, I say, horrible." described one of the first victims of this spell the feeling the ghost chill gave. While practically useless against undead, this spell can send a living man into shivering stupor. Some members of the order even refuse to use this offensive spell because of the ghastly nature of it. It has maintained its position in the teaching lists mostly because it can also be used in a bit less hostile manner - you can cast the spell onto a weapon, and the weapon will deliver small bits of this ghost chill to the target.Usage: cast ghost chill at <target>

ghost companion.name: ghost companion
ghost companion.description: This spell calls a ghost to fight with you. The ghost is intangible and thus ignored by your opponents, even though its damage is very real. With a target, the spell tries to use the ghost with the selected name, and without target the current selected ghost is used.This is as close to necromancy as you get without actually being a necromancer. While the ghost companion is loyal in all situations, it is debatable if it remains so because it wants to or if it is bound to do so, by this powerful spell. Ghost liberators believe the case is the ghosts want to help release their fellow ghosts from the cruel hands of lords of chaos, liches and the like, but not all see it like this, thus the name 'necropaladin' hangs over the order.Usage: cast ghost companion        cast ghost companion at <ghost name>

ghost guidance.name: ghost guidance
ghost guidance.description: This spell helps you and your party to deal extra spell damage against evil opponents. The spell uses up the current selected ghost, or a ghost you target.Offense is the best defense, so they say. With the help of this spell a ghost liberator can imbue his fellow party members with zealous hate of evil - the very same hate that burns in every liberator and nun. This hate, with proper channeling, can be used to cause extra damage on evil targets. Even the already zealous nuns benefit from this effect - this spell might be the only ghost-related effect that Las (gingerly) approves.Usage: cast ghost guidance        cast ghost guidance at <ghost name>

ghost light.name: ghost light
ghost light.description: The first offensive spell taught to new ghost liberators is 'ghost light'. While the punishment dealt by this spell gets higher by the level, it also gets more complicated to cast, requiring more effort and time. The spell tries to draw light from the room, and then release the slowly drained energy in a sharp burst at the target. The spell can also benefit from the ghosts helping the liberator, making this spell a curious mix indeed. While not being as picky about the target's evilness as most other ghost liberator skills and spells, the order suggests you only use it on evil targets.While the order is mostly melee-oriented, Samuel de Montfort's background as parlour magician gave birth to this spell. It started from magic missile, the backbone of starting magician's arsenal. From there the spell grew to this pinnacle of ghost magic. It is said that no two ghost liberators cast the spell the same way, but each has their own way of casting this spell.Usage: cast ghost light at <target>

ghost link.name: ghost link
ghost link.description: This spell returns some of the target's endurance by releasing a ghost. The ghosts refuse to help evil targets, and are generally a bit suspicious about helping others than the caster.There is nothing like a good rest after a day of ghost liberation. Alas, sometimes rest is not an option when you are tired. This spell lets a ghost temporarily possess you and use its power through you, effectively making you a tireless fighter. Tireless until you run out of ghosts or magical fatigue steps in. It is said that de Montfort would have lived a few more decades had he known this technique, developed after his passing - he was poisoned in his sleep by a bitter and vengeful lady he had crossed during his days as parlour magician.Usage: cast ghost link at <player>

ghost sword.name: ghost sword
ghost sword.description: This spell transforms the selected ghost into a ghost sword, a magical tool of divine retribution. The sword is personal, and the ghost leaves your ghost army in the process of sword creation.'Always be prepared.' Sometimes people forget these words of wisdom. For those who misplace or lose their swords, or simply come unprepared, ghost sword offers an excellent way to arm themselves properly to meet the challenges. Powerful ghosts yield powerful blades, and some people even prefer to fight with a ghost sword instead of a real blade.The spell originates from co-operation of Samuel de Montfort and the ghost of a noble dwarven weaponsmith, who had been killed by an undead horde of zombies. The ghost told de Montfort that now in afterlife he could fabricate a sword so sharp no zombie could stand more than a single hit from the blade. De Montfort combined the power of this spell with the skill of the ghost, and a blade was crafted. There was plenty of zombie-slaying, and finally the ghost of the weaponsmith was laid to rest as the blade vanished.Usage: cast ghost sword at <sword type>Available sword types: longsword, katana, falchion, bastard sword, no-dachi, claymore, flamberge and 2h sword.

ghost vision.name: ghost vision
ghost vision.description: Ghost vision helps you see through darkness. It also makes you more perceptive to things around you.Ghost vision is one of the later additions to the curriculum of the order. It came to exists mostly due to the need to see in the unnaturally dark places where not even the greater light spell helps, and since the simple infravision spell requires demonic chants, research on this spell was started.Usage: cast ghost vision at <target>

giant strength.name: giant strength
giant strength.description: This spell affects the recipient's str. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

glance of predator.name: glance of predator
glance of predator.description: Sometimes a slave of Tzarakk may be parted from his or her trusty steed. Luckily the deity allows one to locate the missing lamb, or hellhorse, with a simple spell.

glorification of sin.name: glorification of sin
glorification of sin.description: When the forces of good came up with the seven heavenly virtues and their opposing counterparts the seven deadly sins, many holy nuns and knights of Faerwon chose to live their life following this new moral code. In some communities this new way of life was frowned upon and even publically mocked. It wasn't a lifestyle that suited many noblemen who would prefer to overwhelm themselves with luxurious pleasures. Some other religious sects even made a mockery out of it by glorifying sin, and making it part of their worship. In the early days even new temples were built for this purpose. The powers granted by the glorification can always be renounced with command 'glorification stop'

glory of destruction.name: glory of destruction
glory of destruction.description: As they roam around the countryside, wreaking havoc on everyone they encounter, reavers draw the attention of the powers of destruction. If they are fed enough destructive energy released from broken items and slain creatures, these powers may grant boons to the reaver. The most common boon is this spell, which increases the reaver's overall combat performance for a short time. Syntax: cast glory of destruction at amount <percent> The <percent> is 1% to 100% of the maximum power you can call upon.
glory of destruction.spell_vocals: Grant me the power, the fire from within

glow.name: glow
glow.description: By manipulating an items property, you can cause it to emit light.  Repeated castings with high mastery can cause permanent glow.  Component: item and cesium.

gluttony.name: gluttony
gluttony.description: As Lucy and Emily arrived at the edge of the forest they saw a big brown bear eating carcasses of wild horses that it had mauled to death. They were watching the bear carefully from a distance as it was gorging to satisfy its hunger. They sat there for hours but the bear kept on eating and its hunger was never satisfied. When Lucy and Emily continued their journey they felt bad for the bear. Gluttony is considered to be one of the more serious sins. Some even consider that gluttony can be a gateway to cannibalism while especially the unholiest unliving ones serving Draen-Dalar use this spell to indulge their humane desires.
gluttony.spell_vocals: tastes and delights of nether star, served by thy host Draen-Dalar

go.name: go
go.description: This spell can be used to teleport the caster either to a known location or to one of the directions (northwest, north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest or west). You can also give the direction abbreviated (nw,n,ne,e,se,s,sw,w). You can try to adjust the distance travelled with appending long, medium or short as a modifier to the direction. The higher your mastery is, the shorter modifiers you can use. Give the name of the target location as the target of the spell. Mastery of locating reduces the mana cost of this spell. You will need the skill Location Memory to memorize locations. This is a powerful spell, and will use up just about all of your magical energy during the trip. You can use the qualifier 'ferry' to teleport to your nearest ferry.

golden arrow.name: golden arrow
golden arrow.description: The spell golden arrow is one of the most powerful pure magical spells known. The caster draws a tremendous amount of pure magical power and concentrates it into one blast, a narrow beam, that springs forth, hitting the target with devastating power. It has been said that the intense heat from a golden arrow has melted a suit of full platemail into a heap of molten goo.

golem heal.name: golem heal
golem heal.description: Golem, like all other lifeless items, do not heal as organisms do, even though they have many lifelike characteristics. Further, since they are not technically alive, traditional healing techniques or magic have little to no effect on them. Channellers are able to fix this problem with a minor spell that creates an energy link between them and the golem. A rod of the same material as the golem forms the bridge the energy flows along, and it is known that some rods work better than others. It is worth noting that golems cannot cast this spell upon themselves. Cast transformation affects the healing process.

good berry.name: good berry
good berry.description: One power that is given to even novice druids, is the ability to create magical berries that are very healthful. Upon eating them, strength and vigor are restored. More powerful druids are able to conjure tastier berries, that also last longer without withering away. The spells 'runic heal' and 'vine mantle' improve the berries' healing and duration.

goto ship.name: goto ship
goto ship.description: Ships are screened against teleportation magic by default, but some captains choose to add in special (and often well guarded) chambers which can allow these spells to get through. This spell is particularly adept at locating these chambers and teleporting the caster to them. In general, the range is quite limited; however, if the caster is in one of the teleportation rooms to begin with, the chamber will boost the power of the spell, sending him over much greater distances. Alternatively, if not in such a chamber, the caster may dump extra energy into the spell directly, and extend its range somewhat.

granitize.name: granitize
granitize.description: This spell affects the recipient's con. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

greater create herb.name: greater create herb
greater create herb.description: This is an improved version of create herb spell. Faster but more expensive to cast, this spell can create any herb known to you. The trick is, the herb must be in season to be created. Usage: cast greater create herb at <plant>. Use plant lore at list to get the proper herb names. Please note that creating the most rare herbs can be very taxing on your magical might as Gaia is not too eager to part with such wonderful treasures.

greater darkness.name: greater darkness
greater darkness.description: This spell summons a circle of darkness. The duration is dependent on the level of the caster. To dismiss the darkness, just touch it.

greater light.name: greater light
greater light.description: This spell creates a magic ball of light that follows the caster around. It's duration is dependent on the level of the caster. To dismiss the light, just touch it.

greater magic mount.name: greater magic mount
greater magic mount.description: This spell summons a greater magic mount, a drake. Only most skilled riders may ride this winged mount. The type of the drake is set at the casting time, with the possible targets being 'fire', 'poison', 'magic', 'electricity' and 'cold'. You can also cast the spell to 'refresh', 'dismiss', 'locate' or 'summon' your greater magic mount. You can only have one greater magic mount at a time.

grounding point.name: grounding point
grounding point.description: Everyone knows that lightning has certain things it likes -- metal items, salt water, and outspoken blasphemers are just a few. But what lightning really wants to do is go to the ground. Some say that's why lightning likes high places, like trees and towers, because they let it get to the ground faster. Living creatures are rarely so firmly attached to the earth, which is where this spell comes in. By affixing a magical electrical conduit between the target and the ground, they become a giant target for electricity, no matter how they try to hide, the lightning will seek them out with great vigor.

guardian.name: guardian
guardian.description: The holy guardian is a powerful shield against the attacks of an undead beings. The target is embraced by a shining bright aura of holy power upheld by the saints. The protectee of the holy guardian must be righteus and have a pure heart. You need holy water to be able to cast this spell. The guardian is something the saints give, not something one can demand, so be humble or wrath of Las will surely dictate your destiny.

guardian angel.name: guardian angel
guardian angel.description: It is said that the followers of Tarmalen always have an angel watching over their shoulder. In this world filled with danger and unspeakable hazards, this is a comforting thought  indeed. While the angel may not be able to physically save the follower directly, it can use other means available to it to protect its subject. This spell is self-defense only. Using it to screw other players is forbidden.

gust of wind.name: gust of wind
gust of wind.description: With a favorable wind, a ship can sail at much greater speeds than normal. Thus, most every captain enlists the aid of a friendly druid who can request assistance from the elements. In so doing, the druid creates a small, carefully controlled tempest which keeps the ship's sails filled with air. Of course, larger ships can gain greater benefits from this spell due to their greater number of sails. This spell requires a small amount of prepared feathers to be cast. Races with feathers will automatically choose to pluck themselves if no other feathers are available.

hailstorm.name: hailstorm
hailstorm.description: The most powerful cold based spell is the spell hailstorm. By tapping into the arctic plane, a small storm producing hail is formed that swirls around the target. The hailstones are  similar to ice bolts, that they dissipate their cold energy into the target upon contact. A large number of foes can be caught in this spell at once. Much concentration and effort is needed to call the power needed to create such a storm.

half harm.name: half harm
half harm.description: The effectiveness of this spell is affected by your wisdom, level, spell percent, your ability to hit your opponent, and by your mastery of pain.

hallucination.name: hallucination
hallucination.description: This spell allows the target to see things he otherwise couldn't see. Knowledge of identify lessens the mana cost of this spell.

hangover cure.name: hangover cure
hangover cure.description: There comes a time -- regrettable but true -- in every adventurer's life where he has to snap out of a blissful drunken state into sobriety. Some situations call for drunken debauchery, but others call for clear-headed thinking. This spell is for such a time. One simple incantation will bring even the deepest depths of alcoholism or intoxication to an immediate, pain-free end. You need a chicory root to cast this spell.

harm.name: harm
harm.description: The effectiveness of this spell is affected by your wisdom, level, spell percent, your ability to hit your opponent, and by your mastery of pain.

harm body.name: harm body
harm body.description: One of the most powerful attack spells known, is given by the dark gods to their most faithful followers. It is capable of causing tremendous damage to the target, in such a way, there is no known defense against such an attack. This spell only requires that the caster touches the target. Once this is done, the target's body is racked with heavy wounds which do an incredible amount of damage. Harm body can only take away a maximum of half the target's hitpoints. The effectiveness of this spell is affected by your wisdom, level, spell percent, your ability to hit your opponent, and by your mastery of pain.

harvest vitae.name: harvest vitae
harvest vitae.description: The caster prepares a ritual which begins to drain the very life essence out of the poor victim. If channeled sufficiently long the gruesome practice will rip the victim of its physical prowess, granting its guile to the Hive and the cultist instead. This can later on be passed on to the thralls at his/her command.

heal all.name: heal all
heal all.description: Affected players: All This spell heals affected players in the mud 50+1d50 points. The players will know who healed them. This is considered a very good act. The caster can choose which players are not effected by the spell by ignoring that player with the ignore command (see 'help ignore' for more information). You must specify the minimum number of players that you want to have affected as the target of the spell, for example:  cast 'heal all' 10

heal mount.name: heal mount
heal mount.description: A faithful mount is like a trusted weapon in many respects -- with time, one learns how it moves and reacts, and learns to improve both offense and defense with it. However, they both tend to take damage in combat. Keeping a mount in good condition is just as important as keeping one's sword sharp and one's shield repaired. While not true healers, a knight can soothe an injured mount with his voice, taking away the fear and pain until the wounds have a chance to heal themselves. If a noble mount should become angered or upset, this spell may calm its emotions so it can be ridden again.

heal self.name: heal self
heal self.description: Not suprisingly, one of the first forms of magic that was perfected was the magic to heal one's own wounds.

healbound harmony.name: healbound harmony
healbound harmony.description: The ability of Followers of Tarmalen to heal and aid fellow adventurers is admirable, but their natural talent does not end there. As they perform their craft they have the ability to bound themselves in harmony with one other soul, and through them share their healing with everyone in the group and thus spreading their knowledge as experience. The harmony sometimes pulses so strong, that it replenishes the Follower, or even the whole party. If one wishes to break this bond, they can command 'harmony renounce'.

heat reduction.name: heat reduction
heat reduction.description: Fire has always been one of the most feared elements due to its destructive and relentless abilities. Not only is fire found in its natural form, but many creatures use fire as a form of attack. Many magical weapons burn brightly from magical fires. Due to the common presence of a threat from fire, a spell was created that created a red aura around the target. This aura was able to absorb some of any fire damage done to the target.

heavenly protection.name: heavenly protection
heavenly protection.description: Heavenly protection is a powerful cover against the attacks of evil and undead opponents. This spell can be casted only upon pure people. Duration and strength of the protection are based on caster's intelligence, wisdom and relic. High mastery of shielding and purity of thy heart are required to fully master this spell. The protective aura can be boosted by sprinkles of holy water.

heavy weight.name: heavy weight
heavy weight.description: While magical summons and banishing spells are powerful tools, they are not without remedy. One such remedy is the anti-summons spell called heavy weight. This spell binds the target with magics that prevent summons. This magic is strong enough that the target will not be able to cast most summon spells himself. Sometimes the magic can be defeated as it is not 100%, but currently this is the only anti-summoning spell that is well known. There are rumors that somewhere there are scholars who even now, try to find the right incantations to improve this spell, just recently there has been a discovery of a spell that will remove heavy weight before it wears off. . .

hemorrhage.name: hemorrhage
hemorrhage.description: The followers of the dark gods have been granted many powers with which to inflict pain and suffering on others. By drawing on the power given them by the dark gods, they can, with a touch, cause pain in their targets by causing internal bleeding in the target's body. This is extremely painful, and worst of all, it does not kill. It is only meant to bring endless pain. The effectiveness of this spell is affected by your wisdom, level, spell percent, your ability to hit your opponent, and by your mastery of pain.

herbal healing.name: herbal healing
herbal healing.description: Herbal healing is a folklorist healing spell, drawing power from herbs. You need a herb to cast this spell. The effects depend somewhat on the herb used, naturally healing herbs offering more power. Some other powers of the herb used are also enhanced by this spell. The herb is consumed by the spell. Usage: cast 'herbal healing' <target> use <herb>

herbal poison blast.name: herbal poison blast
herbal poison blast.description: A folklorist offensive spell, drawing power from herbs. You need a herb to cast the spell. The effects depend somewhat on the herb used, naturally poisonous herbs being more effective - some are even poisonous enough to cause a lasting effect. The herb is consumed by the spell. Usage: cast 'herbal poison blast' [target] use <herb>

herbal poison spray.name: herbal poison spray
herbal poison spray.description: A folklorist offensive spell, drawing power from herbs. You need a herb to cast the spell. The effects depend somewhat on the herb used, naturally poisonous herbs being more effective. The herb is consumed by the spell. Usage: cast 'herbal poison spray' [target] use <herb>

herbal remove poison.name: herbal remove poison
herbal remove poison.description: Folklore tells of many ways to cure a poison. One is sauna, one other is rest, but most other remedies are less mundane and more magical. Combining the healing power of herbs with simple magic, a folklorist is able to cure most poisons. You need a herb to cast this spell, and the herb must have inherent healing ability. Usage: cast 'herbal remove poison' <target> use <herb>

here and after.name: here and after
here and after.description: Death can be seen as permanent or as a state of transition. Death is the only thing that is between life and afterlife. The servants of darkness are able to affect the matters between life and unlife. While death is a very difficult concept to handle, a few attempts have been made in warding friends from death, some of them more successful than others.

hoar frost.name: hoar frost
hoar frost.description: One of the powers wielded by the masters of nature, is one of climate and temperature, the power of winter. Using the power stored inside a crystalline plant, they are able to summon forth a hoar-frost which immediatelly envelopes the target. The sudden change in temperate is very brutal to the unprepared, and can cause great harm, especially to uncovered extremeties.

holding pattern.name: holding pattern
holding pattern.description: This incantation prepares the mage to enter a trance where she is ready to unleash single blasts instantenously. Maintaining the trance is extremely delicate, and it can only be maintained for very short periods of time. High mastery helps, but even the strongest minds can only concentrate for brief moments. Actually unleashing the spell is even harder, any distractions can seriously affect the casting. The best way to complete  the trance without distractions is to stay away from other players, as any distracting presence can seriously affect the outcome. Being in trance in the presence of bigger opponents may be dangerous, as you are not concentrating fully at the combat. Unleashing powerful blasts from the trance is taxing, causing the next trance to take more time to establish.

holy armada.name: holy armada
holy armada.description: Faerwon watches over all Holy Wars, wherever they may be. But as the peoples of the world began travelling the seas, new forms of combat broke out which were much less direct than before. So, in order to protect his followers, Faerwon blessed them with a new spell; one which would bring aid to entire ships at a time, rather than just a couple of individuals. Those knights who had greater power could channel this spell more effectively, bringing larger and more potent benefits.

holy bolt.name: holy bolt
holy bolt.description: Holy bolt is an awesome spell of holy type. When casting, fear can be seen even in the eyes of the most biggest and malicious undeads. This spell is only used by the most skilled and able nuns. When successfully cast, massive amounts of divine force starts to coil around caster's relic forming a brilliant pulsing bolt of pure holy energy. When bolt is big enough caster hurls it upon target, inflicting horrific pain as bolt explodes. Upon successfull cast the caster might receive divine inspiration, halving the cast-time of any next spell. Might of the saints with a doze of high discipline improves the effectiveness of the spell. One must still beware the awesome destructive power as the power of this spell has seduced numerous nuns to the dark path.

holy glow.name: holy glow
holy glow.description: With this spell you hide yourself in a cloak of blinding light. The light is holy in origin, thus it only works against evil creatures.Some ghost liberator paladins dislike this spell because they like to face their enemies 'like a man', but none can deny the usefulness of this spell. It is very useful on scouting missions, to see what kind of opponent you are facing, and if you need to call for backup. Alas, many a liberator has fallen prey to the evil hordes they have been snooping on when the spell ends - a sound reminder of the short duration of this trick.Usage: cast holy glow

holy hand.name: holy hand
holy hand.description: Holy hand is the weakest offensive spell of holy type and is often used by apprentice nuns. Holy hand only effects undead beings which are known to strongly resists other forms of magical attacks. When successfully cast, target is embraced and crushed by white holy light emitted from the caster's relic. Purity of thy heart enhances the effectiveness of this spell.

holy lance.name: holy lance
holy lance.description: Holy Lance was first discovered by Sister Broqyanne who found a way to mold the Holy Power into the shape of lightning, striking its foe with great speed. The lightning-like shape made the focal point small thus piercing even the strongest dark defences. She soon discovered that the damage component was rather small but the piercing effect left the foe vulnerable to Holy Force for a short period of time. She soon took this new art into effective use by first lancing her foe a couple of times or more and then using more damaging spells like Dispel Undead or Dispel Evil to exploit the exposed weakness. She would then lance the foe from time to time to keep it vulnerable to Holy Force. This lance-bolting technique Sister Broqyanne developed also had another great effect. By blasting the weakened foe she was able to gain illuminated state, channeling enormous amounts of Holy Power into even more sharp holy lightning, literally splitting her foe into half. Sister Broqyanne, now a powerful Saint was a gifted and fearsome nun. She was widely known to hunt down the biggest, slimiest and nastiest of monsters.

holy way.name: holy way
holy way.description: Long ago it was decided that followers of Tarmalen should be able to gather together easily in order to discuss issues relevant to them all. By using holy way, one follower is able to transport himself to another follower, though only within limits of the surrounding continental realm.

holy wind.name: holy wind
holy wind.description: Holy wind is an awesome spell when facing horde of fiendish undeads. When successfully cast the celestial wind sweeps through caster's surroundings, severely damaging all undeads. Holy wind is a faint sweep of divine power eminating from the wing strokes of the six winged angel, Seraphim. High purity of heart and might of the saints are required to fully master this spell. Holy wind is a symphony to the glory of Las.

icebolt.name: icebolt
icebolt.description: A more powerful version of the spell flaming ice, this spell creates a large bolt of super cold ice, that strikes the target. Not only damaging the target from the force of the impact, upon contact with the bolt of ice, skin will freeze, sometimes enough that it can become brittle. Also the power of the bolt remains enough that the ice reforms around part of the target, then shattering.

identify.name: identify
identify.description: Many items litter the realms. Some are carried by creatures and men, others are laying in hope of being found by some lucky (or unlucky) adventurer. A small portion of these items may be enchanted with special powers and abilities, most of which are not visible to the naked eye. The spell 'identify' is able to discern the workings of many items and can tell some of its attributes. Those who have studied lore and legend and the workings of magic are much more effective in this art.

identify relic.name: identify relic
identify relic.description: Holy relics, used mostly by nuns, are known to have many separate forces bind to them. Years of studying revealed three main streams of power that were upheld by certain groups of saints. These forces were used to banish undeads, dispel evil fiends and cast protective auras. When powerful nun was slain she was transformed into a powerful saint in realm unknown to mortal men. When successfully cast, the caster feels all the different streams of holy magic, their strenght and saints controlling the flow. The magic saint controls is always same, you may study the saints in the library in convent of White Rose.

immolate.name: immolate
immolate.description: By casting this hideous spell, hellfires shoot from the earth to burn not only the intended victim but everything it is touching. Tales have been told of warriors burned so badly that not even their armour survived.

immolate scythe.name: immolate scythe
immolate scythe.description: Most reavers have a fascination with fire that extends beyond healthy admiration. To them, fire is an inspiration, an energy source which has no goal other than to grow in power at the expense of everything it touches. Following this burning desire, reavers have developed this spell, which sets the blade (or other appropriate part) of their wielded weapon ablaze. Destructive energy is not required for this spell.
immolate scythe.spell_vocals: Let this strike true, to burn from within

imprisonment.name: imprisonment
imprisonment.description: No monsters or players may leave the area while the spell is in effect. The players outside can enter, but then they'll be trapped.

infravision.name: infravision
infravision.description: One ability many races in this realm possess, is the ability to see in the dark. This ability allows them to navigate freely in  darkness, without the hinderance of showing their presence with their own light source. Usually an ability that is gained over many generations of living in dark environments, it can also be temporarily instilled through magical means.

inquiry to ahm.name: inquiry to ahm
inquiry to ahm.description: The caster makes an inquiry to Ahm the Ever-changing (the Demigod of Reincarnation) to find out the target's reinc tax. Deciphering the answer is easier if one is proficient with the runic siglas, and high wisdom also helps - novice Druids may end up far from the truth.The spell can also reveal attributes that are lost for the reinc.

instant fermentation.name: instant fermentation
instant fermentation.description: Fermentation is one of the oldest forms of science known to civilized society, and perhaps with the most pleasant results. Normally, the transformation of sugary fruit juices to an alcoholic drink takes time, and the flavors takes time to mellow and meld as well. This spell drastically speeds up the process, creating a healthy dose of booze in seconds.

intelligize.name: intelligize
intelligize.description: This spell affects the recipient's int. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

invisibility.name: invisibility
invisibility.description: One of the most useful spells from the illusion  schools, is the spell of invisibility. This spell will  make the target and all his possesions invisible to the naked eye. There is no better way to go places you normally shouldn't be caught in. Of course there are also magical ways to detect invisible beings, this spell does not offer total impunity.

iron will.name: iron will
iron will.description: One of the most dangerous times for any warrior in battle, is when they are knocked senseless and left unable to defend themselves. Death is usually only an instant away, as foes readily jump to take advantage of such a striken target. One protective spell grants the target an 'iron will' with which to shrug off hits that may normally leave them at their assailant's mercy..

item dispersion shield.name: item dispersion shield
item dispersion shield.description: Channellers, like all other mages, know what kind of wear and tear their hazardous lifestyles can exact on garments or gear. Blasts of fire, spills of acid, and sizzling lightning are day-to-day occurances with them. After learning to channel the energy from inside an object to them, they learn how to pull the energy from outside the object, thereby pulling some of the harmful energies -- kinetic, thermal, whatever -- to them. While this can (and indeed often does) hurt quite a lot, flesh heals and steel doesn't. Channellers often cast this spell on their prized golems, but it will work on just about anything. You can cast this spell at yourself to check how many shields are still active.

jesters trivia.name: jesters trivia
jesters trivia.description: Curiosity was a dominant trait in Loremaster Laaban's character. He wanted to know things that not many cared for, but there was a problem; not always would people open their minds to him for a peek. He would not falter though, not give up, and his insistence resulted in a new song to be sung by all the curious bards.Hint: type 'bjester'.
jesters trivia.spell_vocals: Green skins, white skins, black skins, purple skins. Big minds, small minds, dumb minds, silly minds. Can you see through yourself, I care not, for I can. I can see what you wear and what you bear, disguised or not, you're a book for me to read.

join soul.name: join soul
join soul.description: With this spell you re-join your soul into your being after soul separation.Usage: cast join soul

killing cloud.name: killing cloud
killing cloud.description: One of the most deadly spells known, is the feared spell, killing cloud. When this spell is cast, a heavy mist appears, that envelopes the target area. Any foes caught in the mist are instantly overcome by a mixture of hundreds of deadly poisons. Some victims fall dead instantly as the poisons overload the nervous system. Others simply melt away as poisons eat away at flesh and bone at a mind boggling rate. Those that survive a killing cloud, are instantly on the throes of hell.

kinematic projection.name: kinematic projection
kinematic projection.description: Psionicist deal primarily with a battle of minds. However, in the pursuit of perfecting their own minds, psionicists have learned a few tricks. For instance, it would not be hard to use their mind to manipulate the world around them.   Telekinetic propulsion is a means of taking an object normally fired from a ranged weapon - arrows, bolts, bullets, and stones - and accelerating them to a frightening speed. Usage: cast 'kinematic projection' <target>

kinemortological protection.name: kinemortological protection
kinemortological protection.description: Every creature has its strong sides and its weak sides. This spell draws its power from assessing the strong points of a creature and then creating a protection against those. Be it the touch of a ghost or the claws of a ghoul, this spell protects its target. As the name suggests, not all creatures are affected by this spell, only undead creatures.

kings feast.name: kings feast
kings feast.description: Haydn was a cute little sprite, also a bard. She used to walk in the forests, admiring the tall trees and cute animals (she also used to kick the irritating animals). Once she met a pixie that was in trouble, caught in a web of a bloodthirsty spider. She cut the web with her sharp knife, released the pixie, and since then the pixies have answered to the call of the bards.
kings feast.spell_vocals: If you look behind a spider web, when it is covered with frost, You may see a tiny pixie, who perhaps is a little bit lost. That tiny pixie is full of spirit representing goodness and light, The embodiment of joy and laughter, of passion and sheer delight. In a world of pure imagination, and a mind full of magical dreams, An enchanted forest can exist, and so can a pixie it seems.

last rites.name: last rites
last rites.description: Through the ages, priests have been able to develop a way, with the help of their Dark Gods, to transfer strength when in dire need, based on their teachings in the harming arts. From its limited beginnings as a tool to protect themselves at the last moment, the priests have been able to increase the power and focus of this spell.  By chanting an evil incantation the priests invokes the Dark Gods to help him when he is about to engage in combat. The spell does so by assisting those who are helping the priest in spread harm in the name of their Gods. Whenever the target's instinct is to flee from his aggressor, this evil prayer calls upon the strength of the priest to allow him to continue his fight. Although the Dark Gods do not pleasure intervention into the mortal realm often, they will do so on occasion. Also, at times the Dark Gods may be inclined to aid their priests to astonishing degrees.

lava blast.name: lava blast
lava blast.description: One of the most powerful fire based attack spells is the spell lava blast. This spell gains its tremendous power by tapping the essence of lava, one of the most powerful forms fire can take. Instead of directing flame, or fire energy, a stream of red hot, molten lava springs forth onto the target. The results are terrifying as the target's flesh burns away as the lava envelopes the target. The changing of fire energy into molten lava takes a fair amount of effort and concentration, making this a rigorous spell to cast, but it is also the most powerful composite fire spell that is able to affect a single target.

lava storm.name: lava storm
lava storm.description: While lava blast is as powerful as fire spells get, the spell lava storm enables that power to be cast upon multiple targets. Through this spell, the caster calls forth enough fiery lava to spray an entire area, burning his foes all at once. Enormous effort and concentration is required to bring this much power to bear. This spell is usually too burdensome for all but the most powerful mages to cast.

laying on hands.name: laying on hands
laying on hands.description: This spell heals target slowly, as long as neither he nor the caster moves or fights. The effect increases slowly.

legacy of enthralled.name: legacy of enthralled
legacy of enthralled.description: Once parasite takes over a hosts mind, the host weakens as a sign of rebellion against foreign consciousness. Through magic and evolution Followers of Nergal are able to lend their own power and life force to hosts carrying their own blood. Usage: cast 'legacy of enthralled' help        cast 'legacy of enthralled' jane grant minor wisdom

lessen poison.name: lessen poison
lessen poison.description: While removing poison is usually the best way to deal with that ill, some poisons simply cannot be removed from the victim through any means. This means that either the victim will die, or simply survive the poison and outlast it. One way to aid these  unfortunate souls, is to use magic to give them protection against the poison coursing through their veins. If you can weaken the poison enough, surviving it will be much easier.

levin bolt.name: levin bolt
levin bolt.description: This spell is a powerful spell that uses magic energy against its foe. While this spell is somewhat similar to the spell magic missile, it has several very important differences. Instead of throwing a small bolt of pure magical energy, it  is able to draw more power that enhances the power of the bolt, not only the size, but also the amount of energy, even if the size of the bolt was not increased. While most magical attack spells emit energy that is bright yellow, this spell, due to the highly concentrated energy, shines pure white.

levitation.name: levitation
levitation.description: This spell will levitate the caster above the ground utilizing only the power of the mind. In function this spell is almost like the commonly used spell floating, but to a true psionicist there's a world of difference. For them this spell is pure, a display of complete willpower, whereas floating is more like a petty magic trick.

life leech.name: life leech
life leech.description: The spell drains up to 100 hit points from target, and adds them to the caster's hit points. Casting this spell is considered to be an evil act. You need to be level 15 for this spell to work.

life link.name: life link
life link.description: One of the more unique spells taught by followers of the good gods, is a spell which allows a priest to create a link between himself and another. This link allows them to share physical pain, which can  sometimes allow the both of them to survive an ordeal that may be too great for anyone to face alone. This is a relativly  dangerous spell, since many times both the caster and the target can be lost if the pain is too great for both of them to survive.

lift of load.name: lift of load
lift of load.description: This spell utilizes the magical power of laughter and allows the target to carry more than they normally could.

light.name: light
light.description: While most activities which require the light of day can be planned to coincide with these hours, there are times that this is just not possible. One of the easiest forms of magic, is to use it to create a source of light.  Magic itself usually glows, due to its unstable power when it is beheld on this plane of existance. Therefore bringing a controlled steady magical light is a trivial task for users of magic. The more powerful the caster, the longer the light will last. To dismiss the light, just touch it.

lightning bolt.name: lightning bolt
lightning bolt.description: With this spell, one is able to harness the power of lightning, and direct it forth to the target, in one long bolt. While not of the magnitude of lightning seen in most thunderstorms, it still can cause terrific pain and burning to the target.

lightning shield.name: lightning shield
lightning shield.description: The lightning shield is an energy effect that masks the electric properties of the object it surrounds. Since the protected target now appears to electricity as an inert object, most or all of the damaging energy will go around, rather than through, the aura, and spare the target some pain.

lightning storm.name: lightning storm
lightning storm.description: One of the most powerful spells that harness the power of lightning, is the spell lightning storm. Upon command, several strong bolts of lighting jump from the hands of the  caster, and hammer the target area. Anyone foes caught inside are hit by the powerful lightning bolts. This spell is a very powerful spell, and much effort and concentration is required to conjure multiple lightning bolts.

living poison.name: living poison
living poison.description: Undead creatures have no blood circulation, or living tissue, and are as such immune to most poisons. This spell changes all that. It infects an undead with a living poison, which renders its target vulnerable to poison attacks. The process, while being a painful one, does not harm the creature, but is still considered an attack by most.

lock biter.name: lock biter
lock biter.description: Most locks are metal, and those that aren't still usually have thin, delicate parts. Acid, being fluid, can easily flow into such tiny places and eat away at them. Usually, this opens the lock, but other results have been known to occur... The skill 'cast alchemy' lets you make stronger acid for tougher locks.

lunacy shield.name: lunacy shield
lunacy shield.description: In long, strenuous combats, many warriors find themselves taking damage from an ever-changing number of magical sources. They might face a fiery demon in one minute, only to face a chilling spectre the next. In this mayhem, switching between magical protections is either difficult or impossible. Faerwon grants his followers the lunacy shield to protect them from such madness. This single spell protects its target from whatever type of magical damage they have suffered the most of recently, and updates itself to keep pace with the chaos of battle. Spell percent and mastery affects how much of the damage is prevented. Higher wisdom makes the spell change damage types faster.

lunar inspiration.name: lunar inspiration
lunar inspiration.description: The most studious of mages look for answers everywhere -- old books, ancient tables, forgotten scrolls, and even the celestial bodies. There are some who say the only difference between genius and madness is measured by success, and if the moon is known to cause fits of insanity, then it should prove fits of brilliance as well. This spell grants the caster increased wisdom and intelligence, the exact nature of which sway with the phase of the moon. Method of runemagery is the mastery of this spell, but certain boons and banes have an even greater effect.

magic dispersion.name: magic dispersion
magic dispersion.description: Magical energy has always been used as a powerful weapon. Due to this, certain spells have been woven that take the opposite magical aura. Similar to the field spell, anti-magic-field, this spell is able to create an aura around the target which is able to lessen the amplitude of pure magic that attempts to penetrate it to attack the target. A result of this, is a reduction in damage done when these types of attack spells are used.

magic eruption.name: magic eruption
magic eruption.description: The spell magic eruption is one of the most fearsome spells witnessed on this side of hell. The caster raises both arms, then chants the words and throws his arms down to his side. At that instant, an area designated by the caster is completely enveloped in a golden flash of light. The magical energy swirls for several seconds before burning itself out. Anything that is unfortunate enough to be caught inside, is bombarded by fiery  magic and energy. Not many things are left living inside a magic eruption.

magic missile.name: magic missile
magic missile.description: One of the most common spells used to inflict damage on one's opponent, is the spell magic missile. This spell conjures a small bolt of pure magical energy and directs it at the target. While this spell is considered by many to be a magical damage type attack spell, virtually all mages are taught this spell as their first attack spell. Not only is  it a simple spell to learn, since it uses pure magical energy, it gives the student a chance to learn other basic concepts about magic.

magic mount.name: magic mount
magic mount.description: Walking is not always a viable option. This spell summons a magic mount, a pegasus. A somewhat skilled rider can ride it, for others it works as a beast of burden. You can only have one magic mount at a time. You can dismiss the mount with 'cast magic mount at dismiss' and increase the duration with 'cast magic mount at refresh'. You can also locate your mount with 'cast magic mount at locate'. If you and your magic mount get separated, you can call your mount with 'cast magic mount at summon'.

magic wave.name: magic wave
magic wave.description: The spell magic wave is not only a very powerful attack spell, but also very impressive to see. The caster utters the command and waves his hand from one side to the other, tracing a glowing path that hovers for an instant.  It then leaps outward, catching anything in its path. The wave moves outward from the caster until its energy is spent.

magica pandemonica.name: magica pandemonica
magica pandemonica.description: Mila took a small herbal pouch from her pocket. Carefully smelling that the small piece of chickweed root hadn't gotten rancid, she reluctantly took a bite. "That is disgusting.", Mila exclaimed. Krystina watched her closely as she was spitting it out. She stood there watching Mila, unimpressed. "Try again.", she said to Mila. She took another bite from the chickweed and grimaced while reciting her prayer. Daniela looked at Krystina with a worried look on her face as a strong wave of pressure struck Mila down. "Don't, worry, child. This is not her end.", Krystina said, "This is her beginning.".This powerful spell is known to enhance one's arcane capabilities, but it is also known to be a dangerous process itself and physically exhausting to the body. This prayer of has some drawbacks as it temporarily drains the vitality of the caster, unless the spell is renewed. Some talented gypsy clerics have learned a way to renew the aging cells, thus reversing some of its ill effects.

magnetic levitation.name: magnetic levitation
magnetic levitation.description: Using the power of electro-magnetism, this spell causes a single metal item to rise into the air and follow the caster around, even across teleportation. The magic of this spell means that metals other than iron and steel can be enchanted -- gold, silver, even adamantium can be affected. There is no limit on the number of items a single caster can affect with this spell, however, each item will slowly drain magical energy from the caster at a rate based on its weight. The skill 'cast control' will give some added benefits.

major heal.name: major heal
major heal.description: One of the most powerful healing spells known, is the spell major heal. While some of the weaker spells may still be very effective, most cannot recover the damage from more then one wound at a time. This spells is so powerful that several wounds, as long as only one of the wounds is a major wound, can be healed at once. Internal damage can be healed without any complications.

major party heal.name: major party heal
major party heal.description: When there are times that a multiple target healing spell  is required, the minor spell may not be enough. For these instances, there is a more powerful spell, that will heal major damage to the entire party. Many foes in the world are capable of causing damage in great amounts that may affect the entire party, therefore, a healing spell capable of undoing this damage is needed.

make scar.name: make scar
make scar.description: The dark gods thrive on chaos and destruction. Anything that possesses beauty and order, is a thorn in their sides. Thus, they grant their followers many tools with which to disrupt that which is good. One of these powers, is the devilish ability to permantly marr the physical looks of another. Disfigurement leaves lasting marks that not only can scar the person's outer appearence, but, if they have a weak heart, it can scar their soul as well.

mana barrier.name: mana barrier
mana barrier.description: Magic users are known to be vulnerable to physical stress, as they rely on their wits instead of armour to survive in this harsh realm. However, some of them have conjured up the means to use their intellectual prowess to channel this stress away from them.
