He saw that the accident which the lesser spores spell was fairly minor, and that the resulting spell was also a fairly minor spell. He remembered learning about another  earlier tale, where several practicers of magic were trying to jointly conjure a great amount of power. The result was a tremendous explosion, which killed all who were involved. By researching this event, he was able to recreate the  scope of the energy conjured, and tailor it into a stable form. The result, is a spell, while similar to the lesser spores, that is much more powerful.

summon homonculus.name: summon homonculus
summon homonculus.description: From a heart of a dead monster, you can summon a homonculus. It will obey and worship the ground you walk on... unless your skill is too low. Syntax: cast summon homonculus at heart set <name>. Component: heart.You can also use this spell to bring your homonculus to you. However, it won't work if the homonculus is carrying any items. You do not need a heart for that version of the spell, nor do you need to use a target.

summon lesser spores.name: summon lesser spores
summon lesser spores.description: This spell was first originated when those studying the early potential of magical powers. When they were first trying to conjure magical forces of any kind, they accidently summoned a very unstable form, which immediately exploded in their faces. Some time later, when magic was being used as a tool, as a  weapon, someone remembered reading about that early accident in some old scrolls. They went back and found the old chants and after some research, refined the spell into a form that  was easily and safely used. The resulting spell is able to summon small glowing spheres of energy, that resemble the spores of some plants, that sail towards the target and explode.

summon mount.name: summon mount
summon mount.description: There are times when one must leave behind their mount and travel or fight on foot, for whatever reason. However, when that time is over, the fastest one returns to the saddle, the better. This spell instantly retrieves one's most faithful mount, transporting it to the caster's side -- assuming the mount could enter the room, that is. Only noble mounts can be called with this spell.

summon rift entity.name: summon rift entity
summon rift entity.description: You can use this spell to summon one of your rift entities. The time it takes you to cast will decrease as all your entities grow in power. An entity will disappear if you are not in the front row of the party formation, and suffer a health penalty when you next summon it. Type 'gem entities' for a list of available entities. Syntax: cast summon rift entity at <type/name> This spell uses 5 rift sparks.

summon slaads.name: summon slaads
summon slaads.description: While the worshippers of Burglefloogah often walk alone, they're never left without guidance. The frog god Burglefloogah often watches over those who are in its service. The ones who often offer protection are those who are sometimes met at the Great Swamp. When in despair, the servants of darkness have been known to resort to the help of the slaads. These large froglike creatures who dwell in the marshes are fearsome fighters. The amount of slaads depends from the spell percent as well as caster's wisdom. The slaads are summoned from swamp realms of the caster.

summon squire.name: summon squire
summon squire.description: When a knight is fully equipped with a full set of plate mail armour, a strong shield, a fine lance, a mighty sword, and a good set of adventuring supplies, this rarely leaves a lot of room to collect weapons, armour, and other treasures from any vanquished enemies. When a knight needs an extra hand, or more often two, this spell brings a squire to assist the knight by watching items or mounts until they are called for again.
summon squire.spell_vocals: I need someone to watch this for me

summon storm.name: summon storm
summon storm.description: As the harvest comes, the weather of this world turns harsh and unforgiving. Monsoon winds, thundering storms, sudden blizzards and even shredding hail plague the land. During this troubled time, a druid can tap into this savage fury and wield this force as a brutal weapon.

suppress magic.name: suppress magic
suppress magic.description: This spell will suppress the magical abilities of any creature whom it hits. The monster's resistance is based on its level.

suppressing misery.name: suppressing misery
suppressing misery.description: Brain controls all actions of living beings, when brain becomes compromised so does the defensive and offensive abilities of the victim also. More the disease affects the victims brain less capable the victim is to defend himself and fight back. This spell is in effect while emitting aura through embracing gifts bestowed upon the acolyte by Lord Nergal and thus it cannot be casted by normal means.

sweet lullaby.name: sweet lullaby
sweet lullaby.description: Many a wonderful thing can be achieved by the magical playing of a bard, but not all of them need to be mind-boggling to be useful; so thought Diego the Bard and composed a hypnotic tune to ease the worried minds of his adventuring fellows, granting them a moment of precious rest.
sweet lullaby.spell_vocals: There is nothing you can do, when you realize with fright, that the Spider Queen is having you for dinner tonight... it's much too late to get away, the Spider Queen is having you for dinner tonight.

telekinetic whirlwind.name: telekinetic whirlwind
telekinetic whirlwind.description: Even in the smallest fishing villages of the realm, there is always someone who knows just enough cantrips and trickery to bring smiles to children's faces. These tricks often include moving small items such as spoons and coins without touching them. The ability of controlling material objects from distance without physical contact is often referred as telekinesis. This art comes also in more refined forms either in magnificent displays of control or simply raw force, as is the case here. If you know what you are doing, and possess the needed training and experience, you actually accelerate inanimate objects to speeds that make them fatal projectiles. There is also an additional benefit in this approach, since hardness of the objects may also be altered through willpower making almost anything a potential weapon, as long as they are heavy enough.Weight is an issue here, because to inflict the same amount of damage they require more speed and it is much harder to concentrate on fast-moving targets. Of course, what is considered fast-moving for a beginner is might not be that for a master. Once you have achieved the required level of competence the lighter items are just as deadly as the heavier ones. No matter how good you get, you still have to use enough items as projectiles to make the assaults as efficient and unpredictable as possible.This spell is a sustained attack on a singular target in form of a whirlwind produced by the caster's will. The psychokinetic forces acting on the engulfed items to repeatedly pound on the victim. This type of assualt is very effient, but requires caster's full attetion for the duration of the spell, and is taxing to her magical energy as well as to the items used in it.You may prematurely end the spell with 'whirlwind stop'.

teleport with error.name: teleport with error
teleport with error.description: Long ago, when early studies into teleportation magic  were being conducted, a way to magically move oneself was discovered. Unfortunately, a few of the early scholars were lost when they teleported themselves into cliffs and building walls. This set back the study of this art many centuries. With time, a different method was found to make the memory of location more precise. After a bit, some adventuring scholars went back and managed to find twists to the first teleportation spells that made them  work. Well, at least a little better. This spell, while not perfect, is still much easier to use then the later discovered spells. For the most part there have been no recent records of users of this chant teleporting into solid objects, most may find themselves a couple of metres above the air and land on  their rump, and that  only hurts pride, doesn't it?

teleport without error.name: teleport without error
teleport without error.description: This spell instantly teleports the caster to their starting location. This spell is foolproof and incapable of error. Mastery of locating reduces the mana cost of this spell.

terror.name: terror
terror.description: 'There is nothing to fear, but fear itself.' This saying is attributed to a wise sage, long since left this world. His words proved to be more true than even he could imagine. Fear is existent only in one's mind. This being the case, it is possible to use magical and mental techniques to introduce fear in such a way that even the bravest warrior is turned into a sniveling coward.

there not there.name: there not there
there not there.description: Sight, while usually reliable, must be interpreted by one's mind. Those who practice mental magic, can weave auras of magic around items, so that while they are visible, they do not appear to one's mind, the picture that really counts. This spell does not completely hide an item since those who have a keen mind can sometimes see through the mental illusion.

thorn spray.name: thorn spray
thorn spray.description: The spell thorn spray is used by those skilled in poison magic. Upon command, a short burst of thorns, dripping with poison sail towards the target. While not a deadly poison, upon contact, it does cause great pain momentarily, that fades to mild irritation in several minutes.

touch of glacial winds.name: touch of glacial winds
touch of glacial winds.description: A funnel-like weather phenomenon is an extremely rare event that may occur during winter. On normal circumstances, winter storms are rarely as strong as the weakest summer cyclones. They have relative short lifespans, but can make climate much cooler. With this spell cold mages can summon an arctic storm, which will surround the target slowing down its actions.

touch of madness.name: touch of madness
touch of madness.description: The mind hovers closer to insanity than most people want to believe. A strong psionicist can push a victim's mind just close enough to that border and show them what madness really is. Crippled by sudden visions and impulses, complicated actions, such as spells and skills, become much harder for the struggling victim for a short time. Discipline and psychic resistance will lower the effect of the spell, but even the undead are at least partially vulnerable to the grip of insanity. Mastery prolongs the effect, while knowledge of mental defense increases the likelihood of interrupts.

toxic dilution.name: toxic dilution
toxic dilution.description: Poisons, whether magical or non-magical, can make any encounter deadly. If used against defenseless targets, poisons are usually unstoppable. Certain magical means provide some degree of protection against this type of attack. One such mean casts a magical aura over the target which allows one some resistance and immunity to poisonous attacks. While it doesn't make one completely immune, it does help alot, and may be the difference between victory and defeat.

transfer mana.name: transfer mana
transfer mana.description: Magical power is not a completely unknown measurement. Magic exists in different forms and in different magnitudes. The powers that individuals possess, can sometimes be transferred from one person, to another. This is useful if one has drained his magical resources, yet may need to conduct activities that require his magical abilities. Another who has retained his magical power, can transfer a portion of his power to another. This spell is similar to the evil spell mana drain, but requires a voluntary sponsor of magical power.

transform golem.name: transform golem
transform golem.description: While some channellers throw together golems from assorted litter for quick, menial jobs, other spend time and effort making large, beautiful constructions with great strength and power. Naturally, they would like to protect their investment. This spell allows them to change their servants into small figurines or back, making them considerably easier to store. The effect of this spell on other types of golems is unknown and considered risky. Cast transformation increases the size of golems you are allowed to manipulate.

transform rift entity.name: transform rift entity
transform rift entity.description: Once a riftwalker has control over a number of different entities, he/she can transform their existing entity into another entity type. NOTE: solo kills will NOT register on the top kills plaques for 30 minutes after using this spell. Syntax: cast transform rift entity at <type/name> This spell uses 1 rift spark.

transmute self.name: transmute self
transmute self.description: Using magic, crafty individuals can drastically change their appearence. This may allow them to move unhindered in an area normally impassable to them, or allow them to hide unnoticed in a room. To use this spell one only needs to have present the item or person he wants to take the shape of. It is also said that the gods will punish severely anyone who attempts to take their image, as this is blasphemy.

travel.name: travel
travel.description: With this spell a tree navigator is able to travel through other navigators' nodes without paying the fee. Valid target is an existing link to another node when standing before another one. Opening the rift uses either mana or endurance depending on navigators characteristics.

true harm.name: true harm
true harm.description: It is rumored that in the Old Times, there existed even more powerful harm spells than harm body. Some ancient texts mention Lady of Lamentations, also known as the Great Hag-Queen of the East, being able to channel the very essence of harm itself. That spell was called 'true harm' but the knowledge of the spell vocals themselves is long forgotten. Not much is known from the spell, but like other harm spells, this one required the caster to touch her target. When touched, the target gained some external and internal injuries, obviously causing intense pain. The effectiveness of this spell is affected by your wisdom, level, spell percent, your ability to hit your opponent, and by your mastery of pain.

true heal.name: true heal
true heal.description: It is said that the most powerful healing spell known is so powerful that it is just short of being able to restore life to  a dead target. Virtually any wound of any magnitude can be healed with this spell. Even complete limbs which have been torn off can  sometimes be replaced. It's general consensus that if this  spell is unable to recover an individual, its best that you spend the magical power to resurrect him, not heal him.

true party heal.name: true party heal
true party heal.description: Anyone who has undertaken the task of attempting to  defeat a powerful foe, such as a large dragon know that they have the capability to defeat the entire party at once, or at least to cripple it in an instant. The only way to recover from such a devestating action is to be able to heal the entire party, with great effectiveness. This spell does just that. After having half of a party put out of action from a dragon's breath, nothing short of a true party heal may be able to save the party's efforts to this point from complete failure.

uncontrollable hideous laughter.name: uncontrollable hideous laughter
uncontrollable hideous laughter.description: A spell of limited practical use, but still not without merit, is the spell uncontrollable hideous laughter. Said to having originated from some of the smaller, mischief laden folk, such as pixies and leprachauns, this spell will cause the target to find virtually everything downright funny. Well most useful to cheer someone up, or brighten someone's  day, there are few ways better to distract someone then to have them rolling around on the ground laughing themselves to tears.

uncontrollable mosh.name: uncontrollable mosh
uncontrollable mosh.description: One night they did a mosh pit in the center of the room at the institute of entertainment. They drank some wine and had a good time and played all the songs they could ever think of. Then one bard got an idea 'howabout some different music'. The mosh pit was finally entered and the crowd was getting very anxious because of the forecoming. They started to play - total power was released, aggression hit them with a dwarf's battle fury. Their long hair flowing, doing the eight, flying here and there; their bodies slamming into the walls and eachother; people stage-diving into the crowd... Afterwards they felt VERY awful, their heads and neck hurt and bodies were sore. Luckily no one died! The spell spared NO ONE 'xcept the player.
uncontrollable mosh.spell_vocals: III want to ROAR, III want to SLAM, III want to bash your ass! Hit the WALLS! Hit the WALLS! Go, go go I'll screw the BASS! Hit the WALLS! Hit the WALLS!

unholy matrimony.name: unholy matrimony
unholy matrimony.description: The dowry had been discussed by her family and Shana stood by the altar, wondering if she had what it takes to go through with the wedding while she knew deep in her heart that there was someone else she had devoted her life to. There were no mortal men competing for her heart. It was the overlord of darkness himself that she had vowed her life to. She couldn't hold her tongue anymore. Reluctantly she explained her conviction causing embarrassment to the groom and his family. And just like Curath had stabbed Galean out of jealousy, the groom grabbed his dagger and plunged the dagger through her chest. Shana collapsed, becoming unconscious. As the wedding guests rushed to help her they noticed something peculiar. She was calmly asleep, breathing, and despite the newly inflicted wound, the bride of Draen-Dalar wasn't bleeding either.
unholy matrimony.spell_vocals: I beseech thy wisdom my lord

unleash bogs.name: unleash bogs
unleash bogs.description: Bogs are the domain of the swampdwellers. There are many satraps who dedicate their lives in the servitude of toads who often consider themselves as the descendants of their champion, Burglefloogah. Many satraps know that not only are there societies hidden underneath the swamp, but there is also a lot of untapped power ready to be unleashed. It would be unwise of the satrap not to harness power to their own advantage. This is what many satraps have done throughout the ages by using an ancient spell that allows controlling the marshes in fashion that would not be possible with less extraordinary ways.

unpain.name: unpain
unpain.description: By strengthening the mind, and relaxing the body, one can use magical means to help one ignore pain. Once this spell is cast, the target is given enhanced limits to the amount of damage he can withstand before giving in. Every time his pain threshold is tested, he may lose a bit of the extra limits given to him by this spell.

unstable mutation.name: unstable mutation
unstable mutation.description: One of the more recent mental techniques learned by some of the more chaotic orders of psionics is one that boosts the mental and physical limits of the caster. Be warned this is a relatively new enchantment, and is not yet fully understood, side effects may be dangerous.

unstun.name: unstun
unstun.description: This prayer helps the target against stuns from physical and magical sources, slowly wearing off as it absorbs hits that will otherwise interrupt or daze. However, this mental and physical fortitude is not foolproof; damage from the stun is not absorbed, and some particularly powerful stuns can still bypass this protection.

vacuum ball.name: vacuum ball
vacuum ball.description: This spell is similar to the spell suffocation, except  that a larger pocket of space is affected. This allows the spell to affect several targets at once. Any target hit by this spell undergo sharp loss of air around them, causing damage.

vacuum globe.name: vacuum globe
vacuum globe.description: The most powerful asphyxiation spell is the spell vacuum globe. By creating a swirling vacuum area big enough to evelope several targets at once, the effects are devastating. Loss of air, and the damage from the sudden loss of pressure can cause great harm to blood vessels and organs of all the targets affected.

vacuumbolt.name: vacuumbolt
vacuumbolt.description: The most basic of the spells that attack the target is the spell vacuumbolt. This spell causes a small mass of space to become void of air. This mass of airless space, is then directed at the target. When the magic releases  air around the target into the space, this sucks the air from the targets lungs with great force, knocking the wind out of it.

vampiric charm.name: vampiric charm
vampiric charm.description: This spells makes it quite difficult for the target to cast offensive spells or use offensive skills at caster.

venom strike.name: venom strike
venom strike.description: With this spell, the poison mage can strike their target with a very potent poison, with only a thought. After the proper words are spoken, only a gesture is needed to inflict a deadly poison into the victim. Severe pain,  accompanied by dizziness and some loss of motor functions as the poison attacks the nervous system, comes from being inflicted by this spell.

venturers way.name: venturers way
venturers way.description: 'We still have to press on', said the heavily breathing slaver. 'But alas, our prisoners cannot take any longer and either can we', telepathed the young beholder-kin. 'So we end the day's march here, ensure that our accompanions will not try anything, and CEASE the one playing the lute.', the monster instructed forward.   Not a moment after heavy masses of a hundred slaves started bashing forward with renewed strength. 'Draen-dalar curse us, they are revolting', were the last words of the slaver before numbing blackness caught him..
venturers way.spell_vocals: ..a few steps to earthen might, a few steps just go ahead me, but do I walk the right direction, is it here or there? Just a few steps, left or right. Spirits are what show the sight.

vigilant melody.name: vigilant melody
vigilant melody.description: Even though bards are known to be a jovial lot, not known of shyness by any means, they are also aware of the fact that there are many beings in the Realms whose intentions are far from being benevolent. As bards also have a habit of traveling alone, the loremasters developed this song to protect.. or at least notify the songweaver of lurking dangers.
vigilant melody.spell_vocals: Lost I am not but knowledge I seek for there, my friend, lies a true path for wisdom. With a clouded mind one can not think, but small fog may enhance a presence.

vine mantle.name: vine mantle
vine mantle.description: Druids are able to call upon nature to assist them in their duties and activites. One power they may choose to learn, is to use plants as a physical barrier. This barrier covers the target and protects them from damage to some extent. These vine coverings can be layers, but can also become difficult for the target to bear, as they are burdensome if stacked.

war ensemble.name: war ensemble
war ensemble.description: Whenever war ensemble is echoed in the skies, men on the battlefield get encouraged and their battle-lusts back! It is one of the most influential bard songs dealing with battle.
war ensemble.spell_vocals: War is TOTAL massacre, sport the war, war SUPPOORT!!!

water walking.name: water walking
water walking.description: Most of the world is covered in water, which makes it very impassable, unless you have a boat. This fact resulted in one of the earliest magical spells, one that allows one to walk over the water, as if it were dry land. This spell is very useful since the user does not touch the water at all, nice for keeping one's feet dry.

wilderness location.name: wilderness location
wilderness location.description: This spell tells you the number of rooms east,west,north,south you must travel to get to a location memorized by location memory. You may also use a player as the target, and if the player is on the globe, it will tell directions to the player. It shows you straight line calculation, which doesn't navigate around mountains, but it is possible that you will get ground-based path which would avoid those pesky mountains.Example use: cast wilderness location at guild              cast wilderness location at player duke
wilderness location.spell_vocals: spirits of nature, show me the way!

wither.name: wither
wither.description: This spell affects the recipient's dex. The spell lasts about 5 to 20 minutes.

wither flesh.name: wither flesh
wither flesh.description: The most evil and powerful spells of Druids, which causes target great pain  while the caster is in the room. Target will also momentarily be very  disoriented from pain. Runic mastery dramatically increases the effect of  this spell. Note: This spell is very powerful and fumble has a similar  nightmarish effect.

wizard eye.name: wizard eye
wizard eye.description: This spell shows a circular map around the caster. You can give it an argument for how large an area it shows. usage: cast wizard eye at 15 (shows 15 spaces around you)

word of apocalypse.name: word of apocalypse
word of apocalypse.description: As the ultimate reaver has surpassed the need to be specialized in his destructive efforts, this spell is for them. It attacks every man, woman, child, or any other living thing who hears the word and who's vulnerabilities the reaver has studied. Each victim suffers a different amount of internal pain and damage based on how well that victim's type or race was studied through word of spite. Only the reaver himself is immune to the spell. Syntax: cast word of apocalypse Find weakness raises the chance of a blighting attack.

word of attrition.name: word of attrition
word of attrition.description: This, the simplest of reaver spells, calls upon the power of destruction against a single item sitting on the ground. Energies appear to hasten the natural entropic forces on that item, making it appear to age suddenly. While this is not truly the case, the effect is the same -- the item is broken down into useless parts. Things found lying around are generally considered to have little value, and as such, reavers who destroy them do not get a lot of credit for it.

word of blasting.name: word of blasting
word of blasting.description: The word of blasting is a potent weapon in the reaver's arsenal. With but a single word, the reaver harnesses dark energy into a concussive force, which can injure, disorient, and possibly kill a single living target. A glowing symbol of destruction accompanies the spell's effect, but does not itself do anything. Training in the skill bash increases the likelihood of disorientation.

word of destruction.name: word of destruction
word of destruction.description: An ancient incantation of great power, the word of destruction is even more dangerous than the word of blasting. It has the same effect on the victim itself, but in addition to the damaging effects, it can also damage or destroy a weapon, shield, or piece of armour the target is using.

word of genocide.name: word of genocide
word of genocide.description: Like the word of slaughter, the word of genocide strikes targets the reaver has learned to destroy through the use of the word of spite. This spell, however, is far more dangerous. Not only does it inflict a more painful strike to those affected, but it hits every single creature in the room of the chosen race -- even those working with the reaver. Affected creatures, blighted or not, often fall to the ground clutching their sides, as the magical strain to their bodies causes massive internal wounds. Syntax: cast word of genocide at <target race> Find weakness raises the chance of a blighting attack.

word of oblivion.name: word of oblivion
word of oblivion.description: The legendary word of oblivion is the most powerful spell the reavers have discovered. They tap into the terrible force of chaos directly, using its all-consuming power to tear apart not just the victim but his armour, his weapons, his clothing, his hopes, his dreams, and his soul. Those few who have proven themselves capable of surviving multiple lashes of this horrifying enchantment have been found cringing and weeping naked on street corners, left with nothing.

word of recall.name: word of recall
word of recall.description: A few crafty users of teleportation magic have devised a neat little trick. Thankfully for the rest of us, they decided to share their secret to their pupils, which gradually found its way into the studies of most novice users of magic. By preparing a special incantation, one can set a safe location, and, in the time of great peril, be instantly  whisked there from danger. While this art is very unrefined yet, it is responsible for saving many novices from  situations they have blundered into unexpectedly. There are also a few more powerful beings who have used this spell to save their hide, but due to pride, this isn't as commonly known case by case... Note: It is also rumored that extreme  knowledge of the teleportation magics can ease the stress  of the sudden teleportation on the user.

word of slaughter.name: word of slaughter
word of slaughter.description: The word of slaughter is a dangerous magical tool that turns a victim's own body against him. Weaknesses of the target's body are used as the victim's joints pull apart, muscles tear, and skin pulls away. While the effect is not often visible, it is quite painful. There is also a chance the target will be blighted by the attack, unable to move or fight as easily as before due to the trauma of the attack. In order to affect a certain type of creature, the reaver must study creatures of that type through the use of the word of spite, the more the better. Find weakness raises the chance of a blighting attack.

word of spite.name: word of spite
word of spite.description: The word of spite is a useful tool for reavers of all kinds. With but a simple word, the caster smites the target with any latent jealousness, bigotry, and bias within his black heart, which tears at the victim's soul. However, a far more important reaction also takes place. As the reaver uses this spell on more and more creatures of a specific race or type, insight into that race or type is used to cause greater effect for the word of slaughter. Creatures resistant or immune to probing effects may be resistant or immune to word of spite.

wrath beyond grave.name: wrath beyond grave
wrath beyond grave.description: Somewhere deep underneath the swamp each satrap keeps their own Tomb of Horrors and only few know the unimaginable abominations that remain buried there. Using very powerful magic, the most talented of priests are able to channel the vigor of their mummies and use it against their enemies. This particular spell targets only those enemies who originate from the same realm as the mummy who provides the vigor for the spell.

wrath of las.name: wrath of las
wrath of las.description: In the old times Gods had solemn agreement not to interfere directly on mortals daily life, especially not to involve other God's territory. That agreement was broken when other Gods, mainly Curath and Oxtoth, conspired with wizards and mortals inflicting the destruction of Sisters of Las. God Las got very angry and handed this spell as a gift to the nun leaders to even the balance between evil and good. With this spell a talented nun may channel the WRATH OF LAS towards the servants of evil Gods. When successfully cast, the divine fire strikes like lightning through caster's relic zapping any evil or undead creature with terrific amount of force. Though Las' wrath is infite the caster must wait certain time before she may channel the wrath again. Because of the divine nature of this spell it may only be used by the members of Synod. This spell is the ultimate tribune to God Las.

youth.name: youth
youth.description: This spell reduces the age of the target creature. It can be cast only to Player Characters. The effect is dependant upon caster's level.

zealotry.name: zealotry
zealotry.description: There are some whose blind devotion to their object of worship, or to good/evil as a concept, goes beyond the accepted limits even for the devout. Such fanatics are often called insane, even by those of the same religion. This spell touches the minds of every living creature in the same area as the caster, promoting the same fanatism. In a nutshell, good creatures become more good, evil creatures become more evil, and neutral creatures are more likely to pick a side.

zoological protection.name: zoological protection
zoological protection.description: Every creature has its strong sides and its weak sides. This spell draws its power from assessing the strong points of a creature and then creating a protection against those. Be it the sting of a scorpion or the hug of a grizzly, this spell protects its target. As the name suggests, not all creatures are affected by this spell, only animals.
